blocks.text: Modern family life is full of screens. Parents have their work and interests. Children have their games and entertainment. Everyone has something to watch, discover, share, or finish before the day ends. But for Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes, the best moments are still the ones that bring everyone back together. Together with their son Sixto, the couple brings a distinctly family-centered take to DITO’s new Life Maxxing campaign. Their days, like those of many Filipino families, can move quickly between individual worlds. Marian can be catching up on what’s new, discovering ideas, and sharing things that catch her interest.
